_comment: Background sub-agent notices and hand-backs (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-agent-notices-design.md) and the notice runs they open (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-background-notice-runs-design.md). Read by the Mac MightyCore AgentNoticeTests and the Windows Core checks. Shapes follow Claude Code records; IDs and text are made up. No stream's main result holds a notice section (MightyGraphSupport.noticeSectionMark): every answer to a notice is a notice run's. agentLogLacks lists text the block's log must not hold. noticeRuns counts the runs '<run>:notice:<n>' the stream opened, noticeRunChildren is each one's number of copied blocks (in n order), noticeRunOutput is the first one's main output (null: none) and noticeRunInput its main input, read in Korean ('<block title> · 완료|실패|중단됨' per line). A notice turn about blocks an earlier notice run already holds opens no run: its answer goes on in that run's output after a blank line; a turn that also brings a new block opens a run for the new blocks only, and the earlier run ends in the state it had before that turn. A turn about blocks of two earlier notice runs answers in the first one it names. noticeRunTitles is every notice run's main title, in n order, read in Korean ('<kind> · <name>', '<kind> · <first> 외 <n>개' or '<kind>' alone; a run holding copies is named after them, one without by what opened it); noticeRunOutputs is every notice run's main output (null: none). A root message about no block a run copies (a running agent's message, a sender this session does not know, a notification for work this run never started) after the request's result opens a run of its own: 하위 에이전트 메시지 for a message (named after a known sender), 백그라운드 작업 완료 for a notification; its line is the run's input. noticeTitles is the pure title rule: kind (a locale key, read in Korean) and names in, title out. awaitingNotice is the awaiting-notice rule (BackgroundNoticeRuns.awaitingNotice) over the first run of runs, read with all of them: null when it awaits nothing, else how many of its background tasks' notices are in and each task's status in block order. resultTitles is the pure result-title rule: status and awaiting (BackgroundNoticeRuns.awaitingNotice) in, locale key out. A notification that brings neither a summary nor a status, with no block to copy, opens no run until an answer to it arrives; that answer opens a finished run of its own. An answer that goes to a notice run taken into the request's turn brings the lines that turn held into its input. Consecutive messages from one running agent go on in its latest 하위 에이전트 메시지 run while no other notice run came after it (the answer after a blank line, the message as another input line); a request opens at most 8 message runs, and past that a message turn goes on in the latest one, which then names its new sender too (each sender once, told apart by its agent block, not its title).
